leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a generic type that excludes all but one property from a union of keys.
Apply conditional types to enforce a single required property from a set.
Implement the RequireOnlyOne utility type using TypeScript's built-in mapped types.
Integrate the RequireOnlyOne type into a function signature to validate parameters.
Manipulate existing object types to restrict property combinations.
Configure a type alias that ensures exactly one property is present from a specified list.
Initialize a variable with a type that requires only one property from multiple options.
